methodologyNotes: Prices sourced by fetching each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14 using WebFetch. Supabase (supabase.com/pricing): all plan prices fetched directly; HIPAA confirmed as paid add-on on Team/Enterprise. Neon (neon.com/pricing and neon.com/docs/introduction/plans): Free confirmed at $0; Launch and Scale are pure pay-as-you-go with no monthly minimum — monthlyUsd recorded as null per billing-model rules; HIPAA confirmed available on Scale with additional charge. PlanetScale (planetscale.com/pricing): pricing is per-SKU metered (arm64/x86-64, HA vs Non-HA), no flat tier — smallest entry is $5/mo for PS-5 Non-HA; recorded as custom billing. Aiven (aiven.io/postgresql): Free=$0, Developer=$5/mo, Startup from $75/mo, Business from $180/mo confirmed; Premium plan exists but specific price not shown on fetched page — recorded as null; HIPAA compliance confirmed since 2018 via aiven.io/security-compliance; BAA not explicitly confirmed on page — baa=null. Railway (railway.com/pricing + docs.railway.com/reference/pricing/plans): Hobby=$5/mo, Pro=$20/mo/seat confirmed; resource rates confirmed ($10/GB-mo RAM, $20/vCPU-mo, $0.15/GB-mo volume, $0.05/GB egress). Render (render.com/docs/postgresql-legacy-instance-types): legacy instance pricing Starter=$7, Standard=$20, Pro=$95, Pro Plus=$185 confirmed; the newer flexible-plan pricing page renders no dollar amounts via WebFetch; legacy prices noted as applicable to existing databases (new databases use flexible plans whose exact instance prices were not retrievable). CockroachDB (cockroachlabs.com/pricing): Basic free tier confirmed (50M RUs + 10 GiB/mo free); Standard at $0.18/hr per 2 vCPUs and Advanced at $0.60/hr per 4 vCPUs confirmed; HIPAA-ready confirmed on Advanced plan. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: Supabase
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from https://supabase.com/pricing on 2026-06-14. Free=$0, Pro=$25/mo, Team=$599/mo, Enterprise=custom confirmed. HIPAA confirmed as 'available as paid add-on' for Team and Enterprise tiers. No BAA language explicitly stated on the pricing page (baa=null). No annual discount percentage published on page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 2 active projects max; 500 MB database size; 50,000 monthly active users; 5 GB egress; 1 GB file storage. Project pauses after 1 week inactivity.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 8 GB disk size per project included ($0.125/GB overage); 100,000 MAU ($0.00325/MAU overage); 250 GB egress; 100 GB file storage; $10/mo compute credits (one Micro instance) included.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: SOC2 & ISO 27001; 28-day log retention; HIPAA available as paid add-on; $10/mo compute credits included. Same storage/egress quotas as Pro.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Designated support manager, 24×7×365 premium support, HIPAA available as paid add-on.

vendors.name: Neon
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched from https://neon.com/pricing on 2026-06-14 (neon.tech/pricing redirects 308 to neon.com/pricing). Free=$0 confirmed. Launch and Scale are purely pay-as-you-go with no monthly minimum; per-page statement: 'no monthly minimum' — recorded as monthlyUsd=null with billingModel=custom. HIPAA confirmed available on Scale plan with BAA required (self-serve, no additional cost stated on pricing page but docs note 'an additional charge'). Corroborated by https://neon.com/docs/introduction/plans.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 0.5 GB storage per project; 100 CU-hours/project/month; 5 GB public egress; permanent free plan, no credit card required.

plans.name: Launch
plans.notes: Pure pay-as-you-go, no monthly minimum. Compute: $0.106/CU-hour; Storage: $0.35/GB-month; Egress: 500 GB included then $0.10/GB; Instant restore: $0.20/GB-month; Extra branches: $1.50/branch-month.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Pure pay-as-you-go, no monthly minimum. Compute: $0.222/CU-hour; Storage: $0.35/GB-month; Egress: 500 GB included then $0.10/GB; Private network transfer: $0.01/GB; HIPAA available (BAA required). Higher availability and compliance vs Launch.

vendors.name: PlanetScale
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from https://planetscale.com/pricing on 2026-06-14. PlanetScale pivoted from a Vitess/MySQL product to also offering native Postgres (EBS and Metal tiers). Pricing is per-SKU and metered — no flat monthly tier exists; the smallest entry point is $5/mo for a PS-5 Non-HA arm64 node. Plans below represent the smallest self-serve entry points per architecture; full SKU range runs to $94,429/mo for large Metal deployments. No HIPAA or annual discount information on the pricing page.

plans.name: Postgres EBS Non-HA (PS-5, arm64)
plans.notes: Single node, 512 MiB memory. Prices based on AWS us-east-1. No high availability; production use not recommended.

plans.name: Postgres EBS HA (PS-5, arm64)
plans.notes: 3-node cluster (1 primary + 2 replicas), 512 MiB memory per node. Prices based on AWS us-east-1. Regional prices vary.

plans.name: Postgres Metal HA (M-10)
plans.notes: 3-node bare-metal cluster, 10 GiB storage included. Prices based on AWS us-east-1.

vendors.name: Aiven
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched from https://aiven.io/postgresql on 2026-06-14. Free=$0, Developer=$5/mo, Startup from $75/mo, Business from $180/mo confirmed. Premium plan tier exists (per backup-retention docs) but specific monthly price was not shown on the fetched pricing page — recorded as null. HIPAA compliance confirmed since 2018 via https://aiven.io/security-compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA). BAA not explicitly confirmed on fetched pages — baa=null. 'Starting from' prices reflect entry-level cloud/region configurations; actual price varies by cloud provider and region.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Single node, 1 CPU, 1 GB RAM, 1 GB storage. No backup retention. Subject to acceptable use policy.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: For test and personal projects. No backup retention. Single node.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: Starting from $75/mo; actual price varies by cloud and region. 2-day backup retention. For test environments with high-performance needs.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Starting from $180/mo; actual price varies by cloud and region. 14-day backup retention. 2-node HA with optional synchronous replication. For business-critical production workloads.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Highest tier; 30-day backup retention; 3-node HA with synchronous replication. Specific monthly price not shown on fetched pricing page — use Aiven pricing calculator at aiven.io/pricing/calculator for exact quote.

vendors.name: Railway
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched from https://railway.com/pricing on 2026-06-14 and corroborated by https://docs.railway.com/reference/pricing/plans. Hobby=$5/mo, Pro=$20/mo/seat confirmed from both sources. Resource usage rates confirmed from docs: RAM $10/GB/month, CPU $20/vCPU/month, Volume $0.15/GB/month, Egress $0.05/GB. Postgres on Railway is deployed as a plugin/service and billed via the same usage-metered model. No HIPAA or BAA mentions found on pricing pages.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: Includes $5/mo usage credit toward resource consumption. Additional usage billed on top: RAM $10/GB-mo, CPU $20/vCPU-mo, Volume $0.15/GB-mo, Egress $0.05/GB. Postgres service billed by actual resource consumption.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $20/month per seat; includes $20/mo usage credit toward resource consumption. Higher limits (1 TB RAM, 1,000 vCPU, 1 TB volume per service), longer log retention, team features. Additional usage billed above credit.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Contractual SLAs, SSO, dedicated support, procurement options. Annual committed spend discounts available.

vendors.name: Render
vendors.provenance: Legacy instance pricing fetched from https://render.com/docs/postgresql-legacy-instance-types on 2026-06-14: Starter=$7, Standard=$20, Pro=$95, Pro Plus=$185 confirmed. Render has launched newer flexible plans where compute and storage are billed separately ($0.30/GB-month for storage, per-instance compute), but the flexible plan pricing page (render.com/pricing#postgresql) returned only navigation HTML with no dollar amounts via WebFetch — flexible instance prices are not fetchable and therefore not recorded. Legacy plans apply only to databases created before the flexible-plan rollout. Free tier confirmed: 1 GB storage, expires after 30 days, one free database per workspace.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 GB fixed storage; expires 30 days after creation (14-day grace period to upgrade); one free database per workspace; no backups.

plans.name: Starter (Legacy)
plans.notes: Legacy instance type — not available for new databases. 256 MB RAM, 0.1 vCPU, 1 GB storage, up to 97 connections. Existing databases only.

plans.name: Standard (Legacy)
plans.notes: Legacy instance type — not available for new databases. 1 GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 16 GB storage, up to 97 connections. Existing databases only.

plans.name: Pro (Legacy)
plans.notes: Legacy instance type — not available for new databases. 4 GB RAM, 2 vCPU, 96 GB storage, up to 97 connections. Existing databases only.

plans.name: Pro Plus (Legacy)
plans.notes: Legacy instance type — not available for new databases. 8 GB RAM, 4 vCPU, 256 GB storage, up to 197 connections. Existing databases only.

plans.name: Flexible Plans
plans.notes: New databases use flexible plans: Basic, Pro (1:4 CPU:RAM), and Accelerated (1:8 CPU:RAM) tiers with storage at $0.30/GB-month. Compute prices per instance size not retrievable from pricing page via automated fetch. See render.com/pricing#postgresql for current instance prices.

vendors.name: CockroachDB
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from https://www.cockroachlabs.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-14. Basic free tier confirmed (50M RUs + 10 GiB/mo free). Standard: 2 vCPUs at $0.18/hr confirmed (~$130/mo at 730hrs). Advanced: 4 vCPUs at $0.60/hr confirmed (~$438/mo at 730hrs). HIPAA-ready confirmed on Advanced plan page. BAA not explicitly stated on pricing page (baa=null). Corroborated by https://cockroachlabs.com/docs/cockroachcloud/plan-your-cluster/. Note: CockroachDB is wire-compatible with PostgreSQL but is a distributed SQL engine, not vanilla Postgres.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 50 million Request Units free per month; 10 GiB storage free per month; scales to zero; 99.99% uptime SLA; up to 30K RU/sec (~60 vCPUs). Overage charged beyond free quota.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Currently in Preview. $0.18/hr per 2 vCPUs (approximately $130/mo at continuous use); usage-metered, no flat monthly minimum. Up to 200 vCPUs, on-demand storage up to 3 TiB, 99.99% SLA. monthlyUsd=null because no flat fee — pure hourly consumption.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: $0.60/hr per 4 vCPUs (approximately $438/mo at continuous use); usage-metered, no flat monthly minimum. Unlimited scaling, up to 99.999% availability (multi-region), HIPAA-ready, PCI DSS, CMEK, unlimited storage. monthlyUsd=null because no flat fee — pure hourly consumption.
